razonamiento: The architecture shows a dual-path data migration and replication architecture from legacy IBM DB2 to DynamoDB and Elasticsearch (OpenSearch). The batch initial load path uses DMS to export DB2 data to an S3 bucket, processed by Spark jobs running on Amazon EMR, which write transformed data to DynamoDB and Elasticsearch. The real-time / streaming path routes changes through Kinesis, consumed by a Lambda function writing to DynamoDB. A second Lambda connects to DynamoDB and synchronizes updates to Elasticsearch. All boxes from the whiteboard are matched to spoken components. The drawn arrow direction between Lambda and DynamoDB (b9->b8) is maintained per reconciliation rule 4. The API box is represented as an ApiGateway node without edges as no connections were drawn or explicitly routed to it.
nombre: Legacy DB2 Migration and Real-Time Sync to DynamoDB and Elasticsearch
